title: Getahead
use_case: Mobile app for mental fitness and mindset training for athletes - personalised training plans, guided audio sessions, self-assessment and progress tracking
source: Kayen Peppa portfolio capture. Native iOS app: My Plan / Progress / + / Support / More tabs; onboarding (event, sport chips, goal cards, mental-strength sliders); session detail; week list with AUDIO / 5 MINS / skill chips; progress bars per skill; session-stats ring; mood check-in. image_original7 is the design-system sheet.
